Dr Olatunde Ogunsola-Oluyemi, daughter of the late veteran Yoruba theatre practitioner, Ishola Ogunsola, popularly known as Ishow Pepper, and veteran actress Evangelist Iyabo Ogunsola, popularly known as Iya Efunsetan, is dead. The news of her death was confirmed on Monday, with tributes pouring in from people in the Yoruba film and theatre industry. PUNCH Online gathered that Oluyemi was one of the daughters of the late theatre icon. Her death was also announced by her friend and colleague, Wumi Olabimtan, in an Instagram post on Monday, in which she described the deceased as one of the closest people in her life. Olabimtan fondly recalled calling her “Aunty Tunde” and “Mummy Iwa”, describing her as a talented woman whose laughter, wisdom and kindness made a lasting impression on those around her. She was married to filmmaker and theatre practitioner Ayo Oluyemi, who is associated with the Ibadan Metropolitan College of Theatre Arts and Cinematography. The cause of her death was not disclosed.
